title: IEEE 802.11: add FTM ranging NTB-specific
description:
Adds dissection of the non-trigger-based-specific subelement of the FTM ranging parameters element.

This is pretty straightforward except for the handling of the min and max time fields. They have (in my opinion) difficult units, so I took the approach of defining units for them to make it more clear, and then also converting them into seconds and adding them as column info. 

This pcap should have a subelement that will be parsed by this commit: https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/uploads/76fd13bab34a4d4d3fdd64b825e83518/prot-ftm-start-resp-stop-ntb.pcap
